extDescription.message: Fills two-factor codes from the Tanooki Auth desktop app, or from your phone, only on the website each account belongs to.

errNoApp.message: Tanooki Auth isn't running. Open the Tanooki Auth app on this computer.

errNotPaired.message: This browser isn't paired with Tanooki Auth yet.

errLocked.message: Tanooki Auth is locked. Unlock it, then try again.

errTimeout.message: Tanooki Auth didn't answer in time.

errLookalike.message: This site looks like $1 but isn't. Tanooki Auth won't fill codes here.

errBadPage.message: Codes can only be filled on websites.

errFramed.message: This page is inside another website, so Tanooki Auth won't fill it.

errQuiet.message: Asked your phone a moment ago.

errWrongSitePhone.message: Your phone sent a code for $1, which isn't this page. Nothing was filled.

errWrongSitePhoneUnknown.message: Your phone sent a code for another website, which isn't this page. Nothing was filled.

errSetupPageFirst.message: Open the website's two-factor setup page first.

errMigration.message: That's a Google Authenticator transfer code. Use "Add account…" in the Tanooki Auth app to import it.

errNoQrVisible.message: No setup QR code visible. Scroll so the whole QR code is on screen, then try again.

errNotSavedHere.message: That account isn't saved for this website.

errReload.message: Reload this page, then try again.

errNoField.message: Couldn't find the code box on this page. Click into the box and try again, or use Copy and paste.

noticeDuplicate.message: That account is already in Tanooki Auth.

errNoQrInImage.message: Couldn't find a QR code in that image.

errNotSetupQr.message: That QR code isn't a two-factor setup code.

errOldApp.message: This version of Tanooki Auth can't add Google Authenticator transfer codes from the browser yet. Update Tanooki Auth, or use "Add account…" in the app.

noticeCheckPhone.message: Check Tanooki Auth on your phone to confirm.

linkOffline.message: Can't reach the Tanooki Auth server. Check your internet connection.

linkUnpaired.message: Your phone is no longer paired. Pair it again.

linkServerSaidNo.message: The Tanooki Auth server said no (HTTP $1).

linkNotLinked.message: No phone is paired with this browser.

linkDenied.message: You tapped Deny on your phone.

linkCodeTimeout.message: Your phone didn't answer in time. Open Tanooki Auth on your phone and try again.

linkAddTimeout.message: Your phone didn't answer. Open Tanooki Auth on your phone. If it never asked you, update the app on your phone: older versions can't add accounts from the browser yet.

usePhoneInstead.message: No desktop app here? Use my phone instead

pairingQrLabel.message: Pairing QR code. Scan it with Tanooki Auth on your phone.

phonePairSteps.message: On your phone, open Tanooki Auth, go to Settings, then "Use with a browser", and tap "Pair a browser". Point the camera at this code.

pairedPhoneHello.message: Paired. Your phone will ask you to approve each code.

codesFromPhoneNoApp.message: The desktop app isn't running, so codes come from your phone.

checkPhoneApprove.message: Check your phone and tap Approve…

noCodeBox.message: Couldn't find the code box on this page. Use Copy and paste it.

openSignInPage.message: Open a website's sign-in page, then click the extension again.

pairNote.message: Connect this browser to the Tanooki Auth app on this computer. You only do this once.

typeSixDigit.message: Tanooki Auth is now showing a 6-digit code. Type it here:

fillTitle.message: Fill the code on this page

useHereTitle.message: Fill on this page, and remember $1 for this account

scanPageTitle.message: Adds the two-factor setup QR code showing on this page

scanning.message: Looking for a QR code… then check the Tanooki Auth app to confirm.

noAccountHere.message: No account saved for this website. Pick one below and click "Use here"; it will be filled automatically next time.

noAccountsYet.message: No accounts yet. Open a website's two-factor setup page and click "Scan page for QR code".
